items.evidence: Valid apiLevel 2.13; p20 used for ≤19 µL, p300 for 106/40/250 µL and 30 µL mixes; no overfill (cells well 50+5+250 µL <360); simulator and over-dispense/empty-well checks pass.

no_cross_contamination failed at (363,'D2'),(364,'B1'),(365,'B1'): p20.transfer(1.0, gg_enzyme, assembly_wells, new_tip='once', mix_after=(3,15.0)) re-aspirates enzyme stock with a tip that has mixed in assembly wells.

Volumes, temperatures, times and reagents (25 µL Q5, 19/5/1 µL DpnI, 37/65 °C, 20 µL GG, 250 µL LB, 42 °C 60 s) match the paper and design table; the contamination flaw is a tip-handling issue rather than a method deviation.
Master mix 13.25 water+5 buffer+0.5 dNTP+0.25 pol per rxn, 19 µL dispensed, plus 2.5 µL each primer and 1 µL template per TEMPLATE_WELLS mapping = 25 µL at 0.1 µM primers, 0.5 ng template.
Comment records 98 °C 30 s, 34 cycles with j5 annealing 30 s, 72 °C 5 min; then 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart, 1 µL DpnI, 37 °C 30 min/65 °C 20 min comment, then cleanup pause, in order.
Each assembly well gets 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, frag2 3, frag5 2, frag6 3, own chromo fragment 2 µL, and 1 µL GG enzyme = 20 µL, in its own well.
Comments record GG program (30×37/16 °C, 60 °C, 4 °C hold), cleanup eluted in 10 µL, 5 µL transferred to TOP10 wells, ice 30 min, 42 °C 60 s, 250 µL LB+dextrose, 37 °C 60 min, kanamycin plating.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the paper's quantities and workflow, and the PCR, DpnI, assembly and transformation items are correct. Tips and contamination fails because the shared Golden Gate enzyme transfer uses one tip with mix_after, which re-aspirated the stock after the tip had mixed in assembly wells. The measured no_cross_contamination check failed on this.
